content.text: shared.ada.skipToMainContent Welcome to the Cincinnati Saint Patrick's Parade Countdown to 2027 St. Patrick's Parade on March 13 352 Days 11 Hours 21 Minutes 56 Seconds The Cincinnati St. Patrick's Parade is produced by the Cincinnati St. Patrick's Parade Committee. The committee is composed of residents from both Ohio and Northern Kentucky. On Saturday, March 13, 2027 the Cincinnati St. Patrick's Parade will celebrate its 59th year.
